title: BPW-2026-0503
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0503
BOE
REQUEST TO WITHDRAW BIDS – MACARTHUR LAKE STORMWATER CAPTURE PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the request to withdraw Bids for Mehta Mechanical Company, Inc., DBA MMC, Inc. and Environmental Construction, Inc. for the MacArthur Lake Stormwater Capture Project.
(W.O.: S33WMLRP, S043MSWC, S343MSWC)
summary: Approval of bid withdrawal requests from Mehta Mechanical Company, Inc. and Environmental Construction, Inc. for the MacArthur Lake Stormwater Capture Project.
